correctness.rationale: Solving the calibrated ODE yields Q_j=C(X^j-Z^j). Two ratios give s=X+Z and v=X²+XZ+Z²; Δ=4v−3s²=(X−Z)² recovers both endpoints and amplitude under exact strict deployment-domain inequalities. Perturbing X and Z oppositely proves a continuum of two-read aliases. Differentiating the inverse at fixed Q1,Q2 gives |∂log C/∂log Q3|=2(1+r+r²)/(1−r)², r=e^(−kh), yielding the exact limit 6. The fully factored Jacobian is C²k²XZ(X−Z)^4>0 for physical coordinates. A distinct rational alias, exact rational witness, and 47,013 independent supplementary assertions (from the included checker) are consistent with the proof. The check is finite; universal correctness rests on the displayed algebra.

value.rationale: The 2024 aqueous monitoring work identifies unknown episodic-exposure timing as a concrete limitation of passive samplers. The precise information limit (two simultaneous samplers cannot determine pulse start, stop, concentration; three can under explicit feasibility) is useful as an ideal experimental-design benchmark. The exact, lag- and concentration-independent local amplification 2(1+r+r²)/(1-r)², with sharp 6/(kh)² short-event degradation, provides a mathematically meaningful warning that structural identifiability alone does not imply practical resolution. It is not a routine parameter renaming, a known numerical table, or a claim of field-ready performance.
